headline: Duke Energy to issue $10B in equity to capture gas generation growth opportunity
summary: President and CEO Harry Sideris said the company is deploying more than $1 billion per month to meet “record demand.” Advocates in North Carolina say the utility has exaggerated growth projections to justify its spending plan.

headline: Amazon-Duke Energy Diesel Power Plans For NC Data Center Face Legal Pushback
summary: Environmental attorneys and community groups have urged North Carolina regulators to reject applications from Amazon and Duke Energy to operate diesel generators at a $10 billion data center
